## MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the Current Market Regime?**
NEUTRAL, with normal volatility at 28.8% and narrow participation: 0/8 sectors positive over one week. Breadth remains the key weakness despite volatility staying below the high-risk threshold.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Relative leaders, though still negative, are Banking & Finance (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -4.74%), Holding & Investment (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -7.57%) and Transportation (1W: -2.67% | 1M: -6.83%). GARAN (1W: +2.08% | 1M: +2.00%) is ABOVE TREND; TAVHL (1W: +2.81% | 1M: -0.17%) is in RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Construction & REIT is weakest (1W: -12.56% | 1M: -11.48%), followed by Energy & Chemicals (1W: -8.50% | 1M: -14.74%) and Heavy Industry (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -14.74%). No sector posted a positive weekly return.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
TAVHL (1W: +2.81% | 1M: -0.17%) is in RECOVERY; GARAN (1W: +2.08% | 1M: +2.00%) is ABOVE TREND. SAHOL (1W: +1.42% | 1M: -2.84%), ISCTR (1W: +1.26% | 1M: -3.02%) and YKBNK (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -0.39%) are in RECOVERY.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
TKFEN (1W: -29.40% | 1M: -25.74%) and KONTR (1W: -20.20% | 1M: -42.96%) are BELOW TREND. TRMET (1W: -12.33% | 1M: -9.04%), VESTL (1W: -11.94% | 1M: -34.22%) and GUBRF (1W: -10.78% | 1M: -18.77%) are also BELOW TREND.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
The strongest weekly moves came from TAVHL (1W: +2.81% | 1M: -0.17%), in RECOVERY, and GARAN (1W: +2.08% | 1M: +2.00%), ABOVE TREND. SAHOL (1W: +1.42% | 1M: -2.84%), ISCTR (1W: +1.26% | 1M: -3.02%) and YKBNK (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -0.39%) posted smaller rebounds and remain in RECOVERY.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Banking Sector Outlook?**
Banking & Finance is the relative sector leader, but remains negative on both periods (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -4.74%). GARAN (1W: +2.08% | 1M: +2.00%) is ABOVE TREND, while ISCTR (1W: +1.26% | 1M: -3.02%) and YKBNK (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -0.39%) are in RECOVERY; AKBNK (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -5.02%) is BELOW TREND.

**8. Industrial Sector Outlook?**
Heavy Industry is weak (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -14.74%); all cited names are BELOW TREND. EREGL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.20%), FROTO (1W: -9.55% | 1M: -12.11%) and ASELS (1W: -5.71% | 1M: -13.55%) show no confirmed reversal.

**9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?**
Energy & Chemicals is among the weakest sectors (1W: -8.50% | 1M: -14.74%). TUPRS (1W: -7.28% | 1M: -12.97%), SISE (1W: -5.59% | 1M: -10.40%) and SASA (1W: -10.70% | 1M: -28.94%) are all BELOW TREND.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Maintain a defensive, selective stance and avoid broad risk additions while breadth is 0/8 and all sectors are negative. Favor relative resilience over indiscriminate dip-buying; require broader participation and improving weekly momentum before increasing exposure.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
Watch GARAN (1W: +2.08% | 1M: +2.00%), ABOVE TREND, for leadership confirmation, and TAVHL (1W: +2.81% | 1M: -0.17%), in RECOVERY, for follow-through. Track ISCTR (1W: +1.26% | 1M: -3.02%), in RECOVERY, while monitoring downside risk in KONTR (1W: -20.20% | 1M: -42.96%), BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
Monitor Banking & Finance for any broadening beyond its relative leaders, and Transportation for follow-through after its relative outperformance. Construction & REIT remains the key downside risk after the steepest sector decline.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
No XU100 index levels or event catalysts were provided, so specific price levels cannot be stated. Key triggers are a move above zero in sector breadth and sustained weekly gains in relative leaders; further breadth deterioration would reinforce defensive positioning.

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The market remains NEUTRAL by the supplied regime reading, but normal volatility at 28.8% contrasts with very weak breadth at 0/8 sectors positive. Banking leaders and select recovery attempts offer relative opportunities, while broad-based declines and sharp weakness in Construction & REIT, Energy & Chemicals and Heavy Industry keep downside risk elevated.
